EasyTier-EUI.desc: 简化使用EasyTier的一种UI界面，快速组网
EasyTier-EUI.author: BoB
EasyTier-EUI.changelog:
*鉴于EasyTier2.7.0版本存在已知问题较多，此版本默认内核仍为2.6.4，想尝鲜的可到【配置】页面自行切换内核*
----
- 新增：【节点】页面，主机名列悬浮显示对应服务节点的URI
- 优化：【配置】页面，安卓版本支持本机检测初始节点连通
- 修复：兼容EasyTier2.7.0内核
-----
- 优化：安卓版本默认开启打开时恢复上一次未关闭组网功能
- 优化：GitHub资源下载优化
- 修复：【节点】页面，PC版本节点检测异常问题
- 修复：linux-aarch64 系统 natmap 下载失败问题
- 修复：没有配置且后台获取公共节点时，日志输出解析配置文件失败问题
-----
- 优化：配置文件名开放更宽松字符限制，并前端提示受限错误提示
-----
- 优化：【STUN】页面natmap 下载安装，避免弱网环境下安装提示错误
----
- 新增：【节点】页面，卡片列表支持显示公共节点对应的监听地址
- 优化：【配置】页面，PC版本开机自启适配 EasyTier 2.7.0 新增 --core-args 参数
- 修复：适配 EasyTier 2.7.0 更严格的配置文件校验。TOML配置文件加密算法配置key由 compression 改为 data_compress_algo，选项值为 None、 Zstd
----
- 新增：支持安卓快捷设置磁贴
----
- 优化：适配 EasyTier 新发版规则，支持 Nightly 预发版本下载
- 修复：PC版本设置开机自启，兼容含空格的安装路径 ([Issues #13](https://github.com/710850609/EasyTier-EUI/issues/13))
----
- 优化：【配置】页面，内核 Nightly 版本识别
- 优化：分享配置时，自动识别本地STUN地址，实现一次获取可用自建STUN配置
- 优化：EasyTier文档快捷入口，从【设置】页面移动到【配置】页面
- 优化：安卓版本【设置】页面的【启动重连】功能，迁移到【配置】页面，多配置下精准控制启动。需要重新设置生效
- 修复：PC版本已设置开机自启、运行时，保存配置后，【节点】页面看不到节点信息
- 修复：适配兼容2.7.0以上，2.6.4以下运行，TOML配置文件加密算法 data_compress_algo，选项值改为兼容值：1（None）、2（Zstd）
-----
- 优化：扫码支持打开闪光灯
- 优化：内核更新标识，Nightly 版本不提示更新

----
- New: [Nodes] page, hover on hostname column to display the corresponding service node's URI
- Improved: [Config] page, Android version now supports local initial node connectivity check
- Fixed: Compatibility with EasyTier 2.7.0 core
----
- Improved: Android version enables auto-reconnect on launch to restore the last unclosed network by default
- Improved: Optimized GitHub resource downloads
- Fixed: [Nodes] page, PC version node detection issue
- Fixed: natmap download failure on linux-aarch64 systems
- Fixed: Log output showing config file parse error when no config exists and fetching public peers in background
-----
- Improved: Config filenames now allow more relaxed character restrictions, with restricted error prompts shown on the frontend
-----
- Improved: [STUN] page natmap download and installation, preventing false error prompts caused by concurrent requests on slow networks
----
- New: [Nodes] page, card list now supports displaying the listening addresses corresponding to public nodes
- Improved: [Config] page, PC version auto-start on boot adapts to EasyTier 2.7.0's new --core-args parameter
- Fixed: Adapted to EasyTier 2.7.0's stricter config file validation. TOML config file encryption algorithm config key changed from to , with option values and 
----
- New: Support Android Quick Settings Tile
----
- Improved: Adapted to EasyTier's new release rules, supporting Nightly pre-release version downloads
- Fixed: PC version auto-start on boot, compatible with installation paths containing spaces ([Issues #13](https://github.com/710850609/EasyTier-EUI/issues/13))
----
- Improved: Kernel Nightly version detection on the [Config] page
- Improved: Auto-detect local STUN address when sharing config, enabling one-click retrieval of available self-hosted STUN config
- Improved: Moved the EasyTier documentation quick entry from the [Settings] page to the [Config] page
- Improved: Migrated the [Startup Reconnect] feature from the Android [Settings] page to the [Config] page, allowing precise per-profile startup control. Re-configuration required to take effect
- Fixed: On PC, node info not visible on the [Nodes] page after saving config when auto-start on boot was already enabled and running
- Fixed: Compatibility with versions ≥2.7.0 and <2.6.4; TOML config encryption algorithm option values changed to compatible values: 1 (None), 2 (Zstd)
----
- Improved: Flashlight support for QR code scanning
- Improved: Kernel update indicator — Nightly versions no longer show update notifications
